title: 艾克·时间高桥
description: 少年艾克站在宽阔高桥平台，白色高发、红围巾与背部时间装置明确，工具棒低垂，城市化作远处几何光层。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Ekko is a dark-skinned teenage inventor with a tall white mohawk, a pale painted face marking, a red scarf, and a distinctive time device secured on his back. Preserve his teenage age and lean adolescent proportions rather than making him an older muscular adult. His layered Zaun jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, gloves, and boots fully cover him, while his bat-like tool stays lowered.
art_direction.scene: Frame him pausing on a broad enclosed bridge platform, one foot forward and both soles secure, looking toward distant city towers. The red scarf draws a long diagonal opposite the lowered tool. Strong directional evening light divides his clothes and white hair into rough wax-crayon facets, with a simple railing and large atmospheric city planes rather than a chase scene.
art_direction.palette: white hair, scarf red, deep teal, copper city light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
